newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - August 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - August 26.

text.p: Tamil refugees suffering in Wanni jungles without food or shelter.
Government announces 50 percent pay hike for state sector employees and military personnel.
Lanken Plantations Holdings buys 51 percent stake in Agarapatana Group.
Prime Minister Sirima Bandaranaike tells Deputy Defence Minister Anuruddha Ratwatte not to defame her family.
Three Tamil Tiger rebels killed while trying to plant mine in Amparai.
MEP stages demonstration at Kataragama in campaign to protect Sri Lanka's unity.
Another victim of UNP's terror campaign exhumed at Ja-ela.
